response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember) with no embedded networking, LAN-switch, or network-security background. The role's hard requirements are largely unmet: no native-level Japanese (languages listed are English, Romanian, basic German), no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or source modification, and only brief, decade-old C/C++ experience at National Instruments rather than sustained C UNIX systems development. There is also no evidence of MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal, L2/L3 networking, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDK exposure. The Japanese language requirement alone is likely disqualifying.
strengths: Long, senior-level track record across many domains and stacks
Some C/C++ systems work at National Instruments and Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source contributions
concerns: No native-level Japanese, an explicit hard requirement
No embedded networking, switch, or network-security experience
C programming and kernel-level work are minimal and over a decade old
